title: Nasu language - Wikipedia
text: Nasu and Wusa are two of six Yi languages recognized by the Government of China. Unlike most written Yi languages, Nasu uses the Pollard script. A distinct form of the Yi script was traditionally used for Wusa, though few can still read it.Sino-Tibetan language spoken in China.

title: Nasu, Wusa in China people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Wusa Nasu speak a different language from the several other Yi groups in southern China who use the autonym Nasu. The name Wusa is an ancient tribal name which formerly designated this people group.
